rules.title: Manifest V3
rules.text: Target Manifest V3 with service workers and no remotely hosted code.

rules.title: Minimal permissions
rules.text: Request the minimum permissions and host patterns, and prefer optional permissions.

rules.title: Validate messages
rules.text: Validate the sender and payload of every runtime message.

rules.title: Persist state in storage
rules.text: Persist state in chrome.storage because service workers can be terminated at any time.

rules.title: No inline scripts
rules.text: Avoid inline scripts and eval to satisfy the extension content security policy.
